text: Elias Okafor scored for Harbour City just before halftime after a long, patient build-up with 17 quick passes over nearly a minute, starting deep in their own half. Marek Barros set him up with a clever through ball that split the defense, leading to a neat finish from 14 meters out. Harbour City had been controlling the game with about 57% possession and nearly 90% pass accuracy, and this goal gave them a well-earned 1-0 lead. It was their only shot in the last 10 minutes but a big chance well taken [#905] [#904].
